india6.description: Special judge Kshama Joshi mentions lack of medical evidence, delay in lodging FIR as reasons for acquittal.

india7.title: No extension for NRI deposit scheme relaxations, RBI to end FCNR-B incentives on September 30

india7.title: Facing neglect by kin after providing huge financial support: An NRI's story of exploitation
india7.description: While he was building his career, his elder brother spent five years preparing for government examinations, eventually securing a job at a public sector bank. Throughout this preparation period, the younger brother carried the entire financial burden of the household.

india7.description: Following the NEET issue and minister's resignation, the Cockroach Janta Party plans to address national unemployment, advocating for education reform and media credibility.

india7.title: Earthquake of 5.1 magnitude strikes Arunachal's Upper Siang
india7.description: A 5.1 magnitude earthquake struck Arunachal Pradesh early Thursday, with no immediate damage reported. This tremor followed smaller foreshocks and a subsequent aftershock, occurring in a region prone to seismic activity.

india7.title: Defunct SpaceX rocket, size of school bus, crashes into moon; kicks up lunar dust
india7.description: A SpaceX rocket stage, weighing four metric tons, unintentionally impacted the moon at high speed. Observations revealed sodium and lithium gas in the impact plume.

india7.title: Bombay HC overturns Tarun Tejpal's acquittal, convicts him in 2013 sexual assault case
india7.description: The Bombay High Court overturned Tarun Tejpal's acquittal, convicting him of rape and outraging modesty, a reversal of a prior trial court ruling.

malay2.title: ‘വെള്ളം പോലും കുടിക്കില്ല’: നീണ്ടകരയിൽ വള്ളം മറിഞ്ഞ് കാണാതായ മകനായി അമ്മയുടെ പ്രതിഷേധം
malay2.description: കൊല്ലം∙ നീണ്ടകരയിൽ വള്ളം മറിഞ്ഞ് ഗൗതം കൃഷ്ണയെ (26) കാണാതായ സംഭവത്തിൽ പ്രതിഷേധവുമായി മാതാവ് രേഷ്മ കോസ്റ്റൽ പൊലീസ് സ്റ്റേഷനിൽ. തനിക്കു നീതി ലഭിച്ചില്ലെങ്കിൽ പ്രതിഷേധത്തിൽ നിന്നുപിന്മാറില്ലെന്നും വെള്ളം പോലും കുടിക്കില്ലെന്നും പറഞ്ഞ് രേഷ്മ പൊലീസ് സ്റ്റേഷനു മുന്നിലിരുന്നു പ്രതിഷേധിച്ചു. രേഷ്മയുമായി കൊല്

malay2.title: ബഷീറിനെ വാഹനമിടിച്ച് കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയ കേസ്: ശ്രീറാമിനെതിരെ നിർണായക മൊഴി; ‘കൈകളിൽ രക്തം പുരണ്ടിരുന്നു’
malay2.description: കെ.എം. ബഷീർ വാഹനാപകടത്തിൽ കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട കേസിൽ പ്രതിയായ ശ്രീറാം വെങ്കിട്ടരാമനെതിരെ നിർണായക സാക്ഷിമൊഴി. അപകടസമയത്ത് ശ്രീറാമിന്റെ കൈകളിൽ രക്തമുണ്ടായിരുന്നതായി സംഭവത്തിന് പിന്നാലെ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ കണ്ട സാക്ഷി മിഥുൻ തോമസ് കോടതിയിൽ മൊഴി നൽകി. പിഡബ്ല്യുഡി ഓഫിസ് വാച്ച്മാനും കേസിലെ അഞ്ചാം സാക്ഷിയുമായ മിഥുൻ, അപകടദിവ

malay2.title: ശബരിമലയിലെ ദോഷങ്ങൾ മാറാൻ മൂകാംബികയിലും കാസർകോട്ടും പ്രത്യേക പൂജ; ദൃശ്യങ്ങൾ പുറത്ത്
malay2.description: ശബരിമലയിലെ ദോഷങ്ങൾ പരിഹരിക്കുന്നതിനായി കൊല്ലൂർ മൂകാംബിക ക്ഷേത്രത്തിലും കാസർകോട്ടെ കുമാരമംഗലം സുബ്രഹ്മണ്യ സ്വാമി ക്ഷേത്രത്തിലും പ്രത്യേക പൂജകൾ നടത്തി. 2018ൽ നടന്ന ദേവപ്രശ്നത്തിൽ ശബരിമലയിൽ ദോഷങ്ങളുണ്ടെന്ന് കണ്ടെത്തുകയും പരിഹാരക്രിയകൾ നിർദ്ദേശിക്കുകയും ചെയ്തെങ്കിലും നടന്നിരുന്നില്ല. ശബരിമലയിലെ സ്വർണക്ക

malay2.title: മുത്തങ്ങ കേസ്: വിചാരണക്കോടതിയുടെ വിധി വിശദമായി പരിശോധിക്കണമെന്ന് ഹൈക്കോടതി

malay2.title: യുവമോർച്ചാ നേതാവ് പ്രവീൺ നെട്ടാരു കൊലക്കേസ്: പ്രതികളിലൊരാള്‍ കൊച്ചിയിൽ പിടിയിൽ

japan1.title: “現場職への転職”に20代の約半数が関心 背景にAIへの危機感
japan1.description: 物流や建設などの「現場職」への転職について、20代の転職希望者の半数近くが関心を寄せていることが就職情報会社の調査で明らかになりました。背景にはデスクワークなどの「事務職」がAIに代替される危機感があり、調査した会社は、今後、若者を中心に現場職への転職が増える可能性があるとみています。

japan1.title: ソフトバンクグループ 17％余の減益 4-6月期決算
japan1.description: ソフトバンクグループのことし6月までの3か月間の決算は、最終的な利益は、前の年の同じ時期と比べ17％余り減って、減益となりました。傘下のイギリスの半導体開発会社で人員を増強したことなどが利益を押し下げました。

japan1.title: 円相場は小幅な値動き 再度の市場介入へ警戒感も
japan1.description: 6日の東京外国為替市場、円相場はドルに対して小幅な値動きとなりました。

japan1.title: 株価 値下がり 半導体関連銘柄中心に売り注文
japan1.description: 6日の東京株式市場、このところ値上がりしていた半導体関連の銘柄を中心に当面の利益を確定しようという売り注文が広がり、日経平均株価は値下がりしました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz 8月6日(木) 食料品 消費税1％ 今後の論点は
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: コメ価格見通しを示す指数 過去最低に 民間在庫増の影響も
japan1.description: 向こう3か月のコメ価格の見通しを示す先月の指数が、3か月連続で低下し、過去最低となりました。民間の在庫量がこれまでで最も多く積み上がっていることが背景になります。

japan1.title: ホンダ 4月-6月決算 営業利益が四半期として過去最高に
japan1.description: ホンダはことし4月から6月までの決算を公表し、主力の北米市場でハイブリッド車の販売が伸びたことや、為替が円安ドル高に推移したことなどから、本業のもうけを示す営業利益が5307億円と四半期の決算としては過去最高となりました。

japan1.title: NYダウ 3日連続最高値 ホルムズ海峡開放への期待感から
japan1.description: ニューヨーク株式市場では、中東のホルムズ海峡をめぐり、開放されることへの期待感が高まり、取り引き開始直後から買い注文が広がり、ダウ平均株価は前日の終値と比べて値上がりし、3日連続で最高値を更新しました。

japan1.title: ホンダ 地震で生産に影響 部品メーカーの復旧状況見て再開判断
japan1.description: 大手自動車メーカーのホンダは、熊本県宇城市にあるグループ会社の自動車部品メーカーが被災したことが主な要因となり、自動車の生産に影響が出ていることを明らかにしました。会社では部品メーカーの復旧状況などを見ながら、生産再開を判断することにしています。

japan1.title: 米 ベッセント財務長官 “協調介入は象徴的な意味合い”
japan1.description: アメリカのベッセント財務長官がNHKの単独インタビューに応じました。日米の通貨当局が歴史的な円安を阻止するために先週、実施した円買いの協調介入について、日米連携の象徴的な意味合いだったと述べたうえで、円安の本格的な是正に向けては、日本が打ち出す政策が着実に実施されていくことを確認する必要があるとの認識を示しました。

japan1.title: イオンモール熊本 “LPガス爆発の可能性高い”経産省など調査
japan1.description: 熊本県嘉島町の「イオンモール熊本」で起きた大規模な爆発をめぐって、経済産業省は警察や消防などとともに現場で調査を行った結果、施設に供給されていたLPガスの爆発である可能性が高いという認識で一致したと明らかにしました。

japan1.title: SBI新生銀行 14地銀と協定締結 大型案件融資目指す
japan1.description: SBI新生銀行は全国の14の地方銀行と協定を結んだと発表しました。AI向けデータセンターなどへの投資が活発化する中、連携して大型案件に融資することにしていて、地域経済の活性化につながるかが注目されます。

japan1.title: 【熊本地震 企業影響 5日】大手メーカーの工場など操業に影響
japan1.description: 7月28日に最大震度7の非常に激しい揺れを観測した熊本県。今回の地震の影響で、九州にある大手メーカーの工場などでは操業に影響が出ています。

japan1.title: 熊本地震で9人死亡の日本製紙 初めて記者会見 社長が陳謝
japan1.description: 先月28日の地震で熊本県八代市の工場の煙突が倒壊するなどして9人が死亡した日本製紙は、5日、瀬邊明社長らが地震のあと初めて記者会見を開きました。この中で、瀬邊社長は「9人の尊い命を失い、極めて重く受け止めている。多くの関係の皆さまにご心配とご迷惑をおかけし、深くおわび申し上げます」と陳謝しました。

japan1.title: 円相場は小幅な値動き 中東情勢緩和で午前中は円買いも
japan1.description: 5日の東京外国為替市場、円相場はドルに対して小幅な値動きとなりました。

japan1.title: イオン 7人死亡の大規模な爆発を受け 事故調査委員会を設置へ
japan1.description: 7人が死亡した熊本県嘉島町のイオンモール熊本での大規模な爆発を受けて、イオンは5日、原因究明と再発防止のため、外部の専門家からなる事故調査委員会の設置を決めました。

japan1.title: 異例の介入 米側の思惑は ベッセント財務長官単独インタビュー
japan1.description: アメリカのベッセント財務長官がNHKの単独インタビューに応じました。日米の通貨当局が踏み切った歴史的な円安を阻止するための協調介入の背景について語りました。インタビューの内容の全文を掲載します。（ワシントン支局記者 峯田知幸）

japan1.title: 日経平均株価2300円超上昇 中東情勢の緊張緩和との見方で
japan1.description: 5日の東京株式市場、中東情勢をめぐる緊張が緩和することへの期待感などから多くの銘柄に買い注文が広がって、日経平均株価は2300円以上、値上がりしました。

japan1.title: 高市首相「強い経済」実現と財政持続可能性は両立可能
japan1.description: 高市総理大臣は、経団連の筒井会長と会談し、今後の経済財政政策をめぐり、国内投資の強化を通じた「強い経済」の実現と財政の持続可能性は両立できるという認識を示しました。

japan1.title: ガソリン全国平均170.1円 政府補助金で170円程度の水準続く
japan1.description: 国の委託を受けて調査している石油情報センターによりますと、レギュラーガソリンの小売価格は、3日時点の全国平均で1リットル当たり170.1円と、前の週と同じでした。政府の激変緩和措置による補助金で170円程度の水準が続いています。また、経済産業省は、6日からの出荷分を対象とした補助金の額は、前の週より9.2円減って、1リットル当たり19円になるとしています。

japan1.title: 【きょうのおはBiz 8月5日(水)】クルマづくりのAI活用どこまで
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 財務省 全国の景気判断据え置き 関東と東海は引き上げ
japan1.description: 財務省は全国の景気の現状について、「緩やかに回復しつつある」という基調判断を据え置きました。地域別では「関東」と「東海」の判断を引き上げた一方、「九州」は地震の影響を十分に把握できていないとして判断を示しませんでした。

japan1.title: 日銀 利上げ決定の6月会合の議事要旨 早期の追加利上げ主張も
japan1.description: 日銀は5日、利上げを決定したことし6月の金融政策決定会合の議事要旨を公表しました。会合では、原油高や円安による物価上昇のリスクに対応すべきだといった意見が多数を占めていたほか、この先の追加の利上げも数か月に1度のペースで検討すべきだといった主張が出ていました。

japan1.title: ルーマニア 水位低下により原発一部停止 車生産一時休止も
japan1.description: ヨーロッパで記録的な熱波となるなか、各地で干ばつによる川の水位の低下により原子力発電所の運転を一部停止するなどの動きが相次いでいて、ルーマニアでは電力の消費を抑えるため自動車メーカーの工場が生産を休止するなど影響が広がっています。

japan1.title: 米 スペースX 上場後初の決算 AI開発投資が負担となり赤字に
japan1.description: 宇宙開発やAI事業を手掛けるアメリカの「スペースX」は上場後、初めてとなることし6月までの3か月間の決算を発表し、衛星通信サービスが好調だった一方、AI開発への投資が負担となり、最終的な損益は赤字となりました。

japan1.title: 公取委30年ぶり組織再編へ 中小企業の価格転嫁へ監視強化
japan1.description: 立場が弱い中小企業がコストの上昇分を適切に価格に転嫁できる環境を整備しようと、公正取引委員会は、専門の局を新たに設ける方針です。実現すれば、公正取引委員会にとっては、およそ30年ぶりの大規模な組織再編となります。

japan1.title: NYダウ 2日連続で最高値更新 中東情勢 緊張緩和への期待感で
japan1.description: 4日のニューヨーク株式市場は、中東情勢をめぐる緊張が和らぐことへの期待感などから買い注文が広がり、ダウ平均株価は値上がりし、2日連続で最高値を更新しました。

japan1.title: 三菱重工業 次世代型原子炉「SMR」国内実用化に向け本格開発へ

eu2.title: Brussels vs Beijing: The new trade battle begins in Morocco and Turkey
eu2.description: Beijing's investment drive in Morocco and Turkey is opening new routes into the EU market, forcing Brussels to prepare its response. But its trade defence toolbox is increasingly struggling to keep pace.

eu2.title: HSBC profit jumps as bank unveils major share buyback plan
eu2.description: British banking giant HSBC said on Tuesday it would buy back up to $1 billion (€0.86bn) of shares after reporting a sharp rise in first-half profit.

eu2.title: BP profit more than doubles as Middle East conflict boosts oil prices
eu2.description: British energy giant BP said on Tuesday that its net profit more than doubled in the second quarter as the Middle East war roiled oil and gas markets.

eu2.title: TotalEnergies to buy Shell's wind and solar businesses in Europe
eu2.description: French energy giant TotalEnergies said that it had signed a deal with Shell to buy its European onshore renewable energy businesses for an undisclosed amount.

eu2.title: Second-hand home prices in Spain rise 16.2% in a year
eu2.description: The Fotocasa Property Index puts the average price of existing homes in Spain at €3,154 per square metre in July, 16.2% higher than a year ago. All 17 regions report annual rises, led by Murcia, Cantabria and the Valencia region.

eu2.title: Madrid breaks tourism record, tops €10 billion in international spending in six months
eu2.description: Madrid saw a historic boost in international tourism in the first half of 2026, with spending reaching €10 billion, up 11.4% year on year, according to Spain's National Statistics Institute (INE).

eu2.title: France tightens checks on foreign purchases of 'sensitive' firms
eu2.description: Until now, the Economy Ministry had a say whenever a foreign company bought 25% or more of a French business; that threshold has now been cut to 10%.

eu2.title: Second tanker with Qatari LNG struck in Hormuz within a month as force majeure widens
eu2.description: The GasLog Shanghai was struck while leaving the Strait of Hormuz, weeks after the Al Rekayyat was hit in the same area. Italian utility Edison said QatarEnergy had extended force majeure on a further three cargoes, bringing the total affected to 24 shipments through September.

eu2.title: Major oil companies reap profits as US-Iran fighting drives energy prices higher
eu2.description: Oil and gas giants raked in massive spring profits while fighting between Iran and the US impeded petroleum shipments and consumers around the world paid more for fuel and confronted shortages.

eu2.title: AI demand keeps consumer prices high in 'RAMaggedon' chip crunch
eu2.description: Price rises for goods such as laptops and smartphones, with cars potentially next, have been an unwelcome side-effect of the artificial intelligence gold rush — and the squeeze is far from over.

eu2.title: Alibaba's new Qwen AI claims to match unsupervised working skills touted by Claude
eu2.description: Alibaba's Qwen team says its newest model can design a computer chip and rewrite a research paper — all without a human watching over it, matching skills its rival Anthropic already claims for Claude.

eu2.title: Oil prices lower on Middle East hopes and as OPEC+ boosts production
eu2.description: Oil prices were lower on Monday morning after OPEC+ boosted production for September and US President Donald Trump called off a planned strike on Iran, putting downward pressure on prices.

eu2.title: How Europe’s working day is increasingly encroaching on personal time
eu2.description: One in five EU workers say that they are contacted for work reasons beyond normal working hours many times a month, contributing significantly to always-on culture and adding considerable stress.

eu2.title: Housing in Portugal: Why €400,000 may no longer be enough to buy a home
eu2.description: In Portugal, finding a home under €400,000 is increasingly difficult — and sometimes impossible. The average asking price is now €430,500, according to Imovirtual.

eu2.title: British oil giant BP prepares to sell North Sea business
eu2.description: Amid higher windfall taxes and volatile global energy markets, BP's proposed sale could bring an end to around 60 years of North Sea production under the British energy giant’s ownership.

eu2.title: Apple shares fall despite record revenue as outlook disappoints
eu2.description: Apple’s iPhone revenue jumped by almost 22% in the three months to June, but its forecast for the current quarter fell short of analysts’ expectations.

eu2.title: Time is running out: what trade concessions can the EU win from China?
eu2.description: With an October deadline unlikely to yield major concessions from Beijing given structural and leverage imbalances, EU-China trade tensions look set to keep escalating.

eu2.title: EU expected to probe Balkan construction material imports over suspected Chinese tariff-dodging
eu2.description: There are growing suspicions that certain open mesh fabrics are being made with Chinese glass fibre already hit by EU anti-dumping and anti-subsidy duties for unfair pricing and state support.

eu2.title: How the heatwave is taking a toll on European industry as key waterways run low
eu2.description: Prolonged low water levels have forced several European industries, including oil refining, nuclear power and chemicals, to reduce output because of raw-material and cooling-water shortages.

eu2.title: Microsoft posts record profit as shares surge 10%, while Meta disappoints
eu2.description: Microsoft reported record quarterly profit and forecast accelerating Azure growth, while Meta’s profit and margins were hit by severance costs and legal expenses.

eu2.title: Samsung profit jumps 1,814% as South Korean tech giants benefit from global AI boom
eu2.description: Operating profit at Samsung’s semiconductor division rose to more than 220 times its year-earlier level. However, the company warned that memory chip shortages could worsen next year as AI infrastructure expands rapidly.

eu2.title: Portugal: Air France-KLM and Lufthansa submit binding bids to buy TAP
eu2.description: The government is now expected to receive the report within 30 days and may ask investors to submit an improved final bid.

eu2.title: French wildfires affect 40,000 businesses as disruption spreads
eu2.description: Around 200,000 jobs are connected to businesses affected by the Gironde fires, while the region’s tourism industry and electricity network face mounting pressure.

eu2.title: "He politicises his stance": X, a turning point in Bernard Arnault's communication
eu2.description: The LVMH chief has joined X to hit back at Le Monde after its lengthy probe into his empire and private life, breaking with the media shyness that long defined Bernard Arnault.

eu2.title: BMW plans to cut around 8,000 jobs in major cost-saving drive
eu2.description: The German carmaker has agreed a voluntary redundancy programme targeting administrative and development roles, while ruling out compulsory redundancies and cuts to production jobs, according to media reports.

eu2.title: Porsche profit jumps 34% despite China slump and falling sales
eu2.description: Porsche maintained its full-year guidance as cost-cutting and stronger 911 sales lifted profit, despite a 32% fall in Chinese deliveries and plans to eliminate thousands of jobs by 2035.

eu2.title: The EU wants firms to get faster access to innovation from research labs
eu2.description: A new voluntary charter aims to help startups and SMEs test their products at Europe's cutting-edge laboratories and pilot facilities — cutting the time it takes to bring innovations to market.

bd3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bd3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men

bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

ca3.title: 'Shell-shocked': Residents of Alberta town shaken by large white supremacist training meetup
ca3.description: Second Sons Canada, this country’s predominant white nationalist group, gathered this summer for their annual "nationals" event in a small Alberta town, a CBC News visual investigation has found.

ca3.title: Canadian workers speak out against growing screen time surveillance
ca3.description: Workers at some of Canada's biggest companies say increased workplace surveillance is taking a toll on their mental health as their bosses ramp up the use of software that monitors their screen activity.

ca3.title: Wildfire breaks out in Metro Vancouver's Belcarra Regional Park
ca3.description: A wildfire in Metro Vancouver's Belcarra Regional Park was discovered on Aug. 5, forcing evacuations in the nearby Village of Anmore. The fire is burning roughly one kilometre southeast of Sasamat Lake's White Pine Beach.

ca3.title: Alberta independence group readies its separation blueprint, seeks expert review
ca3.description: One of the leaders of an Alberta separation organization says his group is drawing closer to the release of an upcoming “white paper” exploring the structural policies needed to establish an independent country.

ca3.title: Strathcona County, Alta., rolls out snake safety measures after 1,000 snake deaths in 2 years
ca3.description: Strathcona County is implementing new measures to protect plains garter snakes from vehicle traffic. The move comes after more than 1,000 snake deaths were reported in recent years along a seven-kilometre stretch of Range Road 210, between Township Road 530 and Wye Road heading south.

ca3.title: Climate change made Canadian wildfires in N.W.T. and Ontario roughly twice as likely, analysis finds
ca3.description: A new rapid analysis has found that human-induced climate change has made wildfire in the Northwest Territories and Ontario about twice as likely to occur, and it warns that the world must step away from fossil fuels.

ca3.title: Court authorizes class action against McGill alleging failure to protect Jewish students
ca3.description: The Superior Court of Quebec has authorized a class-action lawsuit against McGill University for allegedly failing to take reasonable action to protect Jewish students from discrimination following the events of Oct. 7., 2023.

ca3.title: Calgarians gather at community vigil to remember boy found dead after lengthy search
ca3.description: Calgarians gathered outside city hall to honour Parker, the 11-year-old boy who went missing from his specialized care facility in mid-July. He was later confirmed dead after a near two-week search.

ca3.title: B.C. wildfire conditions 'explosive and extremely dangerous' as crews brace for more heat, dry lightning
ca3.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service is asking people recreating on Okanagan Lake to clear the way for firefighting aircraft that are gathering water to battle nearby fires.

ca3.title: Manitoba overrules rural school board plan to deprive older students of health-care privacy
ca3.description: A policy in southeastern Manitoba schools that requires staff to ignore provincial law entitling youth 16 and up to make their own health-care decisions must be repealed, the province's education minister says.

ca3.title: Quebec City couple could be on the hook for $20K childbirth tab after work permit delays
ca3.description: A Quebec family says they’ve been stuck in bureaucratic limbo for months, waiting to find out if they can maintain their work permits and provincial health coverage ahead of the birth of their second child.

ca3.title: New Simon Fraser University medical school welcomes first 48 students
ca3.description: Simon Fraser University (SFU) welcomed its first class of 48 students to B.C.'s newest medical school in Surrey on Wednesday. The program will focus on community-based, primary care.

ca3.title: Meet the 1st people to cross Gordie Howe International Bridge on foot and by bike
ca3.description: Opening day on the multi-use path on the Gordie Howe International Bridge was a day of firsts, potential firsts and almost-firsts for several cyclists and pedestrians, as they sought to etch their names into a chapter in history.

ca3.title: Top-ranked Canadian Auger-Aliassime out of National Bank Open after injuring back in practice
ca3.description: Top-ranked Canadian Félix Auger-Aliassime has withdrawn from the National Bank Open after sustaining a back injury during practice in his hometown of Montreal.

ca3.title: Why a Montreal music festival's transparent bag rule is sparking backlash
ca3.description: Just five days before the Montreal music festival, ÎleSoniq announced a strict bag policy allowing only transparent bags. In response to public backlash, the festival updated its rules, but fans say they’re still scrambling to find transparent bag options.

ca3.title: Treaty 6 and 7 women celebrate winning Miss Indigenous Canada titles
ca3.description: Brooke Metchewais from Cold Lake First Nations in Alberta was recently crowned Miss Indigenous Canada 2026. Heather Wolf Ear from Siksika Nation was first runner-up and Miss Congeniality.

ca3.title: Politicians of all stripes descend on Royal St. John's Regatta
ca3.description: Political appearances are as much a part of the Royal St. John's Regatta lakeside traditions as the Crown and Anchor, and this year has proven to be no exception.

ca3.title: Canadian Elite Basketball League title suddenly up for grabs as key absences drastically alter playoffs
ca3.description: The CEBL playoffs are here, but the championship race looks completely different than expected. Suspensions, injuries and key departures have opened the door for new contenders to make a run at the title.

ca3.title: Carney pledges $2.7B for new affordable housing measures in Toronto
ca3.description: The federal government is pledging $2.7 billion over three years to build more than 18 housing projects across the city of Toronto, Prime Minister Mark Carney announced Wednesday.

ca3.title: Move over, Moo Deng: Pygmy hippo calf born at Toronto Zoo
ca3.description: Toronto just got its very own Moo Deng. The Toronto Zoo says a female pygmy hippo calf was born Sunday morning to 20-year-old mother Kindia.
